item.title: Why $499 CPA fees for a US expat return might be overkill
item.description: A US expat return has real complexity. But for Americans in Canada with standard employment income, the forms have a predictable shape.

item.title: T4 to 1040: what every American in Canada needs to know
item.description: Your T4 reports Canadian employment income. Your 1040 needs that income too, in USD. Here is what the conversion actually involves.

item.title: Your tax slips never leave your device
item.description: Lou reads your T4s and T5s, works out your US return and fills the IRS forms, all inside your browser. Here is what that means and how to check it.

item.title: Do you need to file US taxes if you live in Canada?
item.description: Lou is a tax-preparation tool, not a tax advisor. This article explains how the US tax system works for Americans in Canada.
